title: Toddler Boy with Bat & Baby in Stroller, 1950s B&W Outdoor Snapshot Photo
description: A charming mid-century candid photograph capturing a young toddler boy in gingham checkered shortalls holding a small toy baseball bat while leaning near a baby sitting in a vintage metal-frame folding stroller. Taken outdoors in bright sunlight on a gravelly yard setting, this snapshot captures playful sibling dynamics and mid-20th-century American suburban domestic life during the post-WWII baby boom era.
